info.title: Flipzy API
info.description: Flipzy Property Management Platform API - Complete API documentation for property listings, messaging, analytics, and admin features.

post.description: Record a view event for a property. Used for analytics and engagement tracking.
Save a property to user's favorites/saved list. Optional notes and list name.
Record an inquiry event for a property. Used for engagement tracking and credibility scoring.

get.description: Get analytics data for a property including views, saves, and inquiries. Filter by time period.
Get credibility score for a wholesaler based on their properties' engagement metrics.
Get analytics summary for the authenticated wholesaler including total properties, views, saves, and inquiries.
Get all conversations for the authenticated user, ordered by last message date.

post.description: Create a new conversation or retrieve existing one between two users. Optionally link to a property.

property_id.description: Optional property ID to link conversation

get.description: Get details of a specific conversation including participants and property.
Get all messages in a conversation, ordered by creation date (newest first).

post.description: Send a new message in a conversation. Message is broadcast in real-time to the other participant.

body.example: I'm interested in this property. Can we schedule a viewing?

put.description: Mark all unread messages in a conversation as read for the authenticated user.
Mark a specific message as read.

get.description: Get the total number of unread messages for the authenticated user across all conversations.
Display a listing of properties with filters

post.description: Create a new property listing. Requires authentication and wholesaler role.

get.description: Get detailed information about a specific property. Public endpoint.

put.description: Update a property. Only the property owner (wholesaler) can update. Supports partial updates.

delete.description: Delete a property. Only the property owner can delete.

post.description: Upload one or more images for a property. Maximum 10 images, 5MB each.

delete.description: Delete a specific image from a property.

put.description: Set a specific image as the primary image for a property.

post.description: Generate an AI-powered rehabilitation cost estimate for a property. Requires Premium/VIP subscription or admin role. Rate limited based on subscription tier.

get.description: Get history of all rehab estimates generated for a property.
Get detailed information about a specific rehab estimate. Only accessible by admin or the user who requested it.
